scripts.typecheck: tsc -p spacetimedb && tsc -p dashboard && tsc -p scripts
scripts.db:build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/spacetime.mjs build --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.db:publish: node scripts/spacetime.mjs publish sentinel --module-path spacetimedb --server http://127.0.0.1:3000 --yes --no-config
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/spacetime.mjs generate --lang typescript --out-dir dashboard/src/module_bindings --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.db:verify:publish: node scripts/spacetime.mjs publish sentinel-verification --module-path spacetimedb --server http://127.0.0.1:3000 --yes --no-config
